## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests passed (include commands/results)
- [ ] Credentials, prompts and local runtime data are absent
- [ ] Operator impact, compatibility and rollback are described
- [ ] Unverified platforms are explicitly listed

## Review

Request Codex review after enabling the GitHub integration. Address findings on the current commit. A chat statement or a green test job is not an independent approving review.
